title: Wolf's Spider Mod
description: Wolf's Spider Mod adds vanilla style spiders bases off of real world spiders!
body:
Wolf's Spider Mod adds vanilla style spiders based off of real world spiders!

Spiders in this mod are...

1.Black Widow: danger level-10

2.Jumping Spider: danger level-3

3.Orge Faced Spider: danger level-4

4.Orb Weaver Spider: danger level-7

5.Spitting Spider: danger level-8

6.Green Huntsman: danger level-9

7.Wolf Spider: danger level-4

8.Tarantula: danger level-3

9.Brown Recluse: danger level-9

And all spiders in this mod are compatible with [Nyf's Spiders](https://modrinth.com/mod/nyfs-spiders)(highly recomended)!

All textures, model, animations, code, mod, and all other assets of the mod are owned by Rapid Wolf Studios and may not be used, modified, or distributed without expilcit permission from Rapid Wolf Studios.

Q&A

Q-what does danger level 10 mean?

A-It means it will essentially one shot you if you don't have armor.

Q-Will you update to 1.20.1?

A-Yes its already on that version you can get it by subscribing to my Patreon for as low as $1 a  month and you will also get acess to all my other 1.20.1 Patreon only mods(link:[RapidWolfStudiosPatreon](https://www.patreon.com/RapidWolfStudios)).

Q-Can I use this mod in a modpack?

A-Yes you can use this version of the mod for a modpack but not the patreon version.

Q-Will you add new features?

A-Maybe.

Q-Can I ask you a question not listed in this Q&A?

A-Yes if you would like to leave feedback or have any question you can ask me on my Discord  Server(link:[RapidWolfStudiosDiscord](https://discord.gg/fHWU4btKSx))
